raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

GLM-5.3-Flash's checkpoint sets `index_share_for_mtp_iteration: true`: the MTP head computes the sparse indexer top-k on draft step 0 and reuses it on the later steps. Since #57387 the flag is no longer visible on the draft config, so sharing has been silently off. This restores it.

Not a duplicate: I searched open PRs for `index_share_for_mtp_iteration`, `share_mtp_topk_indices`, `glm5_next_mtp` and GLM-5.3-Flash MTP and found nothing covering this.

## Claims

- With MTP on GLM-5.3-Flash, draft steps 1+ reuse step 0's top-k again, as before #57387.
- Accepted tokens per draft step go from 3.28 to 3.42 on GSM8K (MTP 5), and decode throughput is +2.7% at a fixed acceptance length.

## Validation

4x B200, nightly `8cbd5d03`, TP1 x DP4 with expert parallel and #60895's MegaMoE path, MTP 5, one run each.

| | sharing off (main) | sharing on |
|---|---:|---:|
| GSM8K (lm-eval, 5-shot, 1,319 questions) | 0.9704 ± 0.0047 | 0.9750 ± 0.0043 |
| draft steps for that GSM8K run | 58,471 | 56,072 |
| accepted tokens per draft step | 3.28 | 3.42 |
| random 1024 in / 1024 out, concurrency 128, output tok/s | 11,639 | 11,952 |
| mean TPOT | 10.13 ms | 9.90 ms |

The GSM8K rows use real acceptance; the throughput rows fix it with `synthetic_acceptance_length` 3.61.

The GPU runs switched the same proposer flag (`share_mtp_topk_indices`) through a local patch that read it from `text_config`. With this PR's code I ran:

- `tests/config/test_speculative_draft_hf_overrides.py`: 17 passed; the new test fails without the change. Run against nightly `8cbd5d03`, whose `speculative.py` is identical to `main`'s.
- `SpeculativeConfig.hf_config_override` on the real checkpoint config: `index_share_for_mtp_iteration` is `True` (missing before).
- pre-commit on the changed files.

<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>

```bash
vllm serve zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 --data-parallel-size 4 --enable-expert-parallel --max-num-seqs 96 \
  --language-model-only --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":5}' \
  --kernel-config '{"enable_flashinfer_autotune":true,"moe_backend":"deep_gemm_mega_moe"}' \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.97

lm_eval run --model local-chat-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 \
  --apply_chat_template --fewshot_as_multiturn --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=2048 temperature=0.0
# accepted per draft step = vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens / vllm:spec_decode_num_drafts

# throughput rows: same server with
#   "rejection_sample_method":"synthetic","synthetic_acceptance_length":3.61
vllm bench serve --backend openai --endpoint /v1/completions --model zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash \
  --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 --random-range-ratio 0 \
  --num-prompts 512 --num-warmups 64 --max-concurrency 128 --request-rate inf --ignore-eos \
  --temperature 0 --seed 42
```

The remaining serve flags (CUDA graph sizes, KV offload, `--prefix-match-unit 16`) are the ones listed in #60895.
</details>

## Details

- Root cause: the MTP proposers read the flag from the draft config (`mtp/speculator.py`, `llm_base_proposer.py`). The in-tree `Glm5NextConfig` forwarded `text_config` attributes to the top level; the upstream Transformers config that #57387 switched to does not. That PR moved `num_nextn_predict_layers` to `get_text_config()` but not this flag.
- Fix: promote the flag onto the draft config in the `glm5_next` override, as the Qwen4-Exp override already does. An explicit `index_share_for_mtp_iteration` in `--speculative-config` still takes precedence.
- The GSM8K difference is within one standard error; I read it as no regression, not as an accuracy gain.
- Limitations: validated on NVIDIA SM100 only, not on ROCm. Acceptance was measured on GSM8K only.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

detail.title: [Bugfix][GLM-5.3-Flash] Restore MTP index sharing across draft iterations

files.patch:
@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@
 from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
 
 import pytest
-from transformers import PreTrainedConfig
+from transformers import Glm5NextConfig, PreTrainedConfig
 
 from vllm.config.parallel import ParallelConfig
 from vllm.config.speculative import SpeculativeConfig
@@ -270,3 +270,21 @@ def test_mtp_index_share_override(
         speculative_config.draft_model_config.hf_config.index_share_for_mtp_iteration
         is expected
     )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+def test_glm5_next_mtp_override_promotes_index_share():
+    """The flag lives on text_config, but the MTP proposers read the draft config."""
+    config = Glm5NextConfig(
+        architectures=["Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration"],
+        text_config={
+            "num_nextn_predict_layers": 1,
+            "index_share_for_mtp_iteration": True,
+        },
+    )
+
+    draft_config = SpeculativeConfig.hf_config_override(config)
+
+    assert draft_config.architectures == ["Glm5NextMTPModel"]
+    assert draft_config.n_predict == 1
+    assert draft_config.index_share_for_mtp_iteration is True
